treatments.name: Acid Mono
treatments.summary: Fashion's monochrome move: black, white, a single acid accent, and a mono face as display.
treatments.fit: Fashion and streetwear, music, portfolios, drops — anywhere scarcity is the aesthetic.

treatments.name: Atelier
treatments.summary: Ivory, ink, and a whisper of bronze. Tiny letterspaced labels against enormous light serifs; action is ink set in caps; bronze appears on numerals, rules, and hovers, never as a field.
treatments.fit: Hospitality, fashion, galleries, fine dining, high-end real estate, weddings.

treatments.name: Basel
treatments.summary: Black ink on white, one signal red, and a grid that does the talking. Black signs the actions; red is earned.
treatments.fit: Portfolios, studios, architecture, events, annual reports.

treatments.name: Blush
treatments.summary: Cream field with dusty rose strictly decorative — it cannot carry text — and actions handed to the deep gray-blue ink. Softness without an accessibility bill.
treatments.fit: Wellness, therapy, spas, personal care.

treatments.name: Broadsheet
treatments.summary: The serif-plus-sans pairing every publication knows: Playfair headlines over Source Sans body, ink on paper.
treatments.fit: Magazines, essays, reviews, newsletters, any site where reading is the product.

treatments.name: Cherry Soda
treatments.summary: Cream, cherry red, and retro teal under a fat poster serif: the roadside-americana standard.
treatments.fit: Restaurants and diners, breweries, festivals, barbershops, brands built on nostalgia done well.

treatments.name: Civic
treatments.summary: Color-safe utility: white field, one AAA action blue used for actions and focus, gold reserved for secondary emphasis, Public Sans in every role. Chosen for legibility, not fashion — and modern because of it.
treatments.fit: Government and civic services, public utilities, institutional portals, anything where completing the task is the brand.

treatments.name: Cobalt
treatments.summary: A hotter consumer take on the quiet-product standard: pure white field, royal cobalt at full saturation, midnight ink. The same one-blue discipline, a step louder.
treatments.fit: Consumer SaaS, product marketing, startups that want energy without clutter.

treatments.name: Executive
treatments.summary: Fintech authority: ice-gray field, trust-navy actions, a plaque gold as the decorative second. Credibility over friendliness.
treatments.fit: Fintech, wealth management, insurers, professional services.

treatments.name: Gilded Noir
treatments.summary: Black, gold, and a Deco cap face: the luxury combination that has worked since 1928.
treatments.fit: Hotels, spirits, jewelry, theaters, restaurants selling an evening rather than a meal.

treatments.name: Hearth
treatments.summary: Warm paper, soft serifs, and sun-baked accents: espresso ink on cream, paprika pulled redder and darker than the pale-clay default, olive keeping it from full farmhouse.
treatments.fit: Nonprofits, community organizations, food, education, local business.

treatments.name: Heritage Navy
treatments.summary: Navy, ivory, and brass with Garamond throughout: the heritage standard of colleges and clubs.
treatments.fit: Universities, law and letters, publishers, clubs, brands that trade on lineage.

treatments.name: Hot Circuit
treatments.summary: Zinc-black field, acid-green actions with hot pink strictly decorative, pure white headings. Loud, but the ramp discipline holds.
treatments.fit: Creative tech, gaming, agencies and studios that live in dark mode.

treatments.name: Meridian
treatments.summary: Navy, serif authority, and disciplined space. A plainspoken sans does the working text; a serious serif holds the headlines; gold appears the way it does on a building plaque — small, occasional, earned.
treatments.fit: Finance, legal, healthcare systems, government, higher education, B2B services.

treatments.name: Midnight Terminal
treatments.summary: Dark mode's house style: near-black, one phosphor green, grotesque headings, mono details.
treatments.fit: Developer tools, infrastructure, security, technical startups that live in dark mode.

treatments.name: Neo Pop
treatments.summary: Neo-brutalism's signature move: cream paper, fat black borders, hard offset shadows, one loud yellow.
treatments.fit: Creator tools, marketplaces, youth brands, zines, products that want to feel handmade and loud.

treatments.name: Newsprint
treatments.summary: Ink on newsprint with a red pencil: flat paper everywhere, containers drawn in rules, a marker-yellow highlight for selection only, Newsreader carrying display and body under Oswald kickers.
treatments.fit: News, magazines, newsletters, research organizations, universities, serious blogs.

treatments.name: Pastille
treatments.summary: Lavender mist, feather shadows, rounded everything: one variable family in every role, the violet deepened for discipline, mint-teal signaling 'okay' without shouting. Even errors are dusk rose, not alarm red.
treatments.fit: Health apps, HR and people tools, education, therapy, childcare, consumer fintech.

treatments.name: Retro Pop
treatments.summary: The loudest pack in the catalog: the field itself goes bright yellow, white cards throw hard black shadows, and royal purple carries the action. Black anchors text, borders, and shadows; charcoal is reserved for secondary copy.
treatments.fit: Campaigns, events, youth retail, drops.

treatments.name: Riso
treatments.summary: Flat paper, hard black borders, one acid color. Everything flat, everything outlined; chartreuse is a fill and a highlight, never text; press a button and it moves into its own shadow.
treatments.fit: Festivals, studios, zines, campaigns, streetwear, personal sites.

treatments.name: Seafoam
treatments.summary: Pale mint field, deep forest-teal ink instead of harsh black, seafoam actions deepened one step to clear 4.5:1 under white text. Reads calm in patient-facing work.
treatments.fit: Healthcare, clinics, patient portals, wellness services.

treatments.name: Sherbet
treatments.summary: Candy-bright and disciplined: warm milk field, plum-black ink doing double duty as outline, one cobalt action, candy tints rationed to three per view.
treatments.fit: Consumer apps, food and drink, family and kids brands, events, creators.

treatments.name: Slate
treatments.summary: The quiet-product standard: a disciplined gray ramp, one working blue, Inter at tight tracking. Executed casually it reads generic; executed deliberately it reads shipped.
treatments.fit: SaaS product and marketing sites, developer tools, documentation, startups that want to look shipped on day one.

treatments.name: Soft Serve
treatments.summary: The friendly-rounded standard of consumer apps: lavender pastels, deep indigo ink, Nunito everywhere.
treatments.fit: Consumer apps, edtech, family and team tools, anything that should feel easy before it feels powerful.

treatments.name: Soft Studio
treatments.summary: The warm-minimal standard: oat surfaces, a light Garamond, tiny tracked caps, and room to breathe.
treatments.fit: Interiors, photographers, boutique hotels, weddings, lifestyle brands sold on restraint.

treatments.name: Southwestern
treatments.summary: High-contrast desert palette: warm sand field, deep forest-teal ink, terracotta action deepened one step to hold 4.5:1 under white button text, the brighter terracotta kept decorative.
treatments.fit: Hospitality, tourism, regional and food brands with a sense of place.

treatments.name: Stark
treatments.summary: Gallery minimalism: monochrome plus one acid highlight reserved for hover states and tiny badges; body grays soften to medium ash. The page field stays white, with warmth supplied by the stone-toned alternate surface.
treatments.fit: Portfolios, galleries, architecture, agencies that let the work do the talking.

treatments.name: Swiss Classic
treatments.summary: Black on white, one true red, a neo-grotesque, and a visible grid. The foundational modernist standard.
treatments.fit: Agencies, conferences, architecture, cultural institutions, anyone who wants timeless over trendy.

treatments.name: Terra Sage
treatments.summary: The terracotta-sage-cream palette of modern craft brands, set in DM Serif over DM Sans.
treatments.fit: Food and home goods, skincare, cafés, wellness, farm-adjacent brands with a story.

treatments.name: Trust Blue
treatments.summary: The most common corporate palette on the web: dependable blue, cool grays, Montserrat headings over Open Sans body.
treatments.fit: Banks, insurers, B2B services, healthcare admin, anywhere credibility beats personality.

treatments.name: Understory
treatments.summary: Moss, stone, and unbleached paper. The color of the trail, not the postcard of it; one ochre note; texture and light do the work shadows would.
treatments.fit: Wellness, sustainability, outdoors, rustic hospitality, farms and land trusts.

treatments.name: Voltage
treatments.summary: Near-black surfaces, electric cyan doing all the pointing, violet confined to the occasional gradient, monospaced details. Built for people who read release notes.
treatments.fit: Developer tools, SaaS, security, data products.
